name: feelingwise
description: Two Chrome extensions from one tree: Receipts, a signed record on your own computer of what a feed showed, and Off, a fixed-rule feed filter.

scripts.dev: node scripts/new-build-id.mjs && npm-run-all --parallel dev:popup dev:bootstrap dev:content dev:pageworld
scripts.build: node scripts/new-build-id.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=bootstrap vite build && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=content vite build && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=pageworld vite build && node scripts/check-sw-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:off: node scripts/new-build-id.mjs && tsc --noEmit && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=off vite build && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=off-content vite build && node scripts/check-off-bundle.mjs
scripts.package:off: cross-env FW_DEV_RELOAD=0 npm run build:off && node scripts/package.mjs --dist dist-off --out-dir release
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build && node scripts/firefox-package.mjs --product receipts
scripts.build:off-firefox: npm run build:off && node scripts/firefox-package.mjs --product off
scripts.package:firefox: cross-env FW_DEV_RELOAD=0 npm run build && node scripts/firefox-package.mjs --product receipts --zip
scripts.package:off-firefox: cross-env FW_DEV_RELOAD=0 npm run build:off && node scripts/firefox-package.mjs --product off --zip
scripts.package: cross-env FW_DEV_RELOAD=0 npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
